page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a compute-optimized hardware profile designed to maximize processing density per unit of memory resource.

Given the high core count of 96 dedicated vCPUs and the compute-heavy memory ratio, this instance is suited for workloads requiring significant parallel processing power without massive memory footprints. Appropriate use cases include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and large-scale web serving.
